t: This is Edgware Road station, on the Circle, District and Hammersmith and City lines, at the corner of Chapel Street and Cabbell Street. It's also a place of remembrance. On the seventh of July 2005, one of the London bombings took place on a train here. The bomber, Mohammad Sidique Khan, killed himself and six other people. One of them was Stan Brewster, a British engineer who died here. Across central London that day, bombs on three Underground trains and a bus killed 52 people.
